Name: AhCuteArt Color Themed Fairy Royalty
Author: AhCuteArt
Description:
[b][size=5][center]AhCuteArt's Colored Theme Project [/center][/size][/b]

Well, this is the first clothing mod I’ve created. I didn’t intend to make another contest entry for 2026 modfest… but here it is. I doodled the basic wings on my phone with Pixel Studio and finished up the designs on my computer. When they were all done, I thought to myself that it should be easy to create a Fashion Sense mod for them. I jinxed myself because it was not easy. When coding the accessories looked bizarre because of terrible placement and my not understanding the formatting. After A LOT of testing, I got everything to work. 

I created several different types of wings because I wanted more accessories for my current “simple red-themed” SDV file. I had intended to lump the fairy, angel, and demon wings all in one file. But I decided against it for the ease of search and for my own programming sanity. Plus, I have some ideas for outfits that will go with each theme, and it would have been a pain to add them all to one mega file. I manually created each color to make sure each one was as vibrant as I wanted. I feel like the color-changing option washes some of the color out. I didn’t add a color-changing set, but if anyone requests it, I’ll try to figure out how to add it. 

This SHOULD be my last contest mod… probably. All the other color-themed mods will come after the contest. I plan to focus on finishing up a couple Nyapu Retexture portraits, now. If you read this far, thank you so much for reading and checking out my mod. 


[b]Current Colors: Black, Blue, Red, White, Green, Grey, Orange, Purple, Yellow,  Baby Blue, Buttermilk, Lilac, Marigold, Mint, Pink, and Rainbow.
[b]Crown Colors: Gold and Silver.[/b]
[/b][b]
[/b]
[b][size=4]INSTALLATION (Must have Fashion Sense): [/size]
[/b]
1. Unzip and drag the replacement into your mods folder 
2. ﻿Buy the mirror from Pierre's store and use it to add wing accessories or crown hats to your character[b][size=4]

Future Plans:[/size][/b]
I might add clothing to match these accessories in the future.
